verdict.rationale: BVNK docs confirm programmatic wallet creation for crypto and fiat via API, including per-customer provisioning (customer ID/reference) and unique, repeat-use blockchain deposit addresses ('channels') per customer. However, there is no documented explanation of key custody semantics (e.g., who holds private keys, custodial model details, key management/security architecture) beyond generic Hawk auth for API access. Missing for 10: explicit key custody/ownership documentation, technical detail on wallet key management, and independent corroboration of these claims.
